post.description: Exa web search for GEO series; only GEO-verified, eligible series come back.
Which of these accessions exist and pass the eligibility filter.
Search GEO for human bulk RNA-seq series that have NCBI raw counts.

Start downloading the given series in the background.

Returns at once with the session's ``pending`` list; poll ``listDatasets`` until the
accessions you asked for have left it. Each arrives ready, excluded or failed.

get.description: Everything collected so far plus what is still pending.
Short-lived download link for one stored file.

post.description:
Run the pipeline on a collected dataset in the background, one entry per contrast.

Poll ``listRuns`` until the status leaves ``running``. The counts must already be in
the session (``collectDatasets``) and the dataset must be ``ready``.

get.description: Short-lived download link for one run output, e.g. ``report.json`` or ``figures/pca.png``.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.description: result stands but must be read with these caveats (uncertain labels etc.)

error.title: Error
error.description: set when the pipeline stopped on an exception

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: sha256 over the counts file, annotation file, design and parameters; a cached run is only reused when it matches

context.title: Context
context.description: modal harmonized field values (tissue, cell_type, ...) over the samples used, for grouping runs that answer the same question

record.description: None when the download itself failed; see error

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.description: Sample field pairing case and control (e.g. 'donor'); recorded, not modelled

restricted_to.title: Restricted To
restricted_to.description: Sample field -> value the contrast is limited to, e.g. {'time_point': '24 h'}

n_case_used.title: N Case Used
n_case_used.description: observations fitted in the case arm (after collapsing)

gsms_fitted.title: Gsms Fitted
gsms_fitted.description: every GSM that contributed to the fit

collapsed.title: Collapsed
collapsed.description: fitted observation -> GSMs summed into it (repeated samples per block/arm)

GeneLookupRow.title: GeneLookupRow
GeneLookupRow.description: The direct answer to 'is gene X higher in case than control' for one dataset.

matched_queries.title: Matched Queries
matched_queries.description: Which submitted queries found this series

mixed_organism.title: Mixed Organism
mixed_organism.description: True when the series also has non-human samples; they are excluded at fetch time.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Role of a sample relative to the research question.

term.title: Term
term.description: Exact term sent to esearch, for provenance

total.title: Total
total.description: Series in GEO matching the term

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: How the counts matrix columns lined up with the sample sheet and contrast.

error.title: Error
error.description: pipeline error or why the run failed

Sample.title: Sample
Sample.description:
One GEO sample (GSM) with harmonized labels.

``raw_lines`` holds the GEO ``characteristics_ch1`` lines verbatim and ``raw``
the same lines as ``{key: value}``; ``title`` and ``source_name`` are copied
from GEO as-is. Those are the only places an ``evidence`` string may come from.

SampleRecord.title: SampleRecord
SampleRecord.description: One GSM as GEO describes it. Values are verbatim from the SOFT file.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: GSEs still being collected; poll until empty

StepRecord.title: StepRecord
StepRecord.description: One pipeline step: what ran, with which parameters, how long, and what it warned.

hits.title: Hits
hits.description: Accessions that exist and pass the filter

ineligible.title: Ineligible
ineligible.description: Accessions that do not exist or fail the filter

nominated.title: Nominated
nominated.description: Accessions Exa returned, before GEO checks

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Nominated but missing from GEO or ineligible

found_at.title: Found At
found_at.description: Pages where Exa found the accession

genes.title: Genes
genes.description: symbols or GeneIDs to look up

cell_ledger_api__runs__RunRequest.title: RunRequest
cell_ledger_api__runs__RunRequest.description: One design file, as ``cell-ledger run --design`` reads it, plus a few run options.
